from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):

        self.setup_layout("Prerequisite: The Wave Dance (Interference)", [
            "Coherent light sources, like lasers, produce synchronized waves.",
            "When waves overlap, they create an interference pattern.",
            "Constructive interference happens when peaks align for greater amplitude.",
            "Destructive interference occurs when waves cancel each other out.",
            "These patterns encode the light's amplitude and phase."
        ])

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(BLUE)
        
        wave1 = FunctionGraph(lambda x: 0.4 * np.sin(x * 3), x_range=[-1.5, 1.5], color=BLUE)
        wave2 = FunctionGraph(lambda x: 0.4 * np.sin(x * 3), x_range=[-1.5, 1.5], color=CYAN)
        
        self.place_at_grid(wave1, "B3", scale_factor=1.0)
        self.place_at_grid(wave2, "C3", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        self.play(Create(wave1), Create(wave2))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.lecture[1].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        self.play(FadeOut(wave1), FadeOut(wave2))
        
        t_tracker = ValueTracker(-2.5)
        
        def pulse_y(x, center, amp=0.6):
            return amp * np.exp(-((x - center)**2) / 0.15)

        def get_points(center, sign=1):
            base_pos = self.grid["D3"]
            return [base_pos + np.array([x, sign * pulse_y(x, center), 0]) for x in np.linspace(-2, 2, 40)]

        pulse1 = VMobject(color=BLUE)
        pulse2 = VMobject(color=CYAN)
        
        pulse1.add_updater(lambda m: m.set_points_as_corners(get_points(t_tracker.get_value())))
        pulse2.add_updater(lambda m: m.set_points_as_corners(get_points(-t_tracker.get_value())))

        self.add(pulse1, pulse2)
        self.play(t_tracker.animate.set_value(0), run_time=2, rate_func=linear)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#00FF00")
        
        def get_sum_points(center):
            base_pos = self.grid["D3"]
            return [base_pos + np.array([x, pulse_y(x, center) + pulse_y(x, -center), 0]) for x in np.linspace(-2, 2, 40)]
        
        constructive_sum = VMobject(color="#00FF00")
        constructive_sum.set_points_as_corners(get_sum_points(0))
        
        self.play(
            FadeOut(pulse1), FadeOut(pulse2),
            FadeIn(constructive_sum)
        )
        self.wait(2)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        self.lecture[3].set_color("#FF0000")
        
        def get_dest_points(center):
            base_pos = self.grid["D3"]
            return [base_pos + np.array([x, pulse_y(x, center) - pulse_y(x, -center), 0]) for x in np.linspace(-2, 2, 40)]
        
        destructive_sum = VMobject(color="#FF0000")
        t_tracker.set_value(-2.5)
        
        pulse1_d = VMobject(color=BLUE)
        pulse2_d = VMobject(color=CYAN)
        
        pulse1_d.add_updater(lambda m: m.set_points_as_corners(get_points(t_tracker.get_value())))
        pulse2_d.add_updater(lambda m: m.set_points_as_corners(get_points(-t_tracker.get_value(), sign=-1)))
        destructive_sum.add_updater(lambda m: m.set_points_as_corners(get_dest_points(t_tracker.get_value())))

        self.play(FadeOut(constructive_sum))
        self.add(pulse1_d, pulse2_d, destructive_sum)
        self.play(t_tracker.animate.set_value(0), run_time=2, rate_func=linear)
        self.wait(2)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        self.lecture[4].set_color(PURPLE)
        
        circle = Circle(radius=0.7, color=GREY)
        self.place_at_grid(circle, "E3", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        phasor = Arrow(color=PURPLE, stroke_width=4, buff=0)
        amp_label = Text("Amplitude", font_size=18, color=PURPLE)
        phase_label = Text("Phase", font_size=18, color=PURPLE)
        
        amp_label.next_to(circle, UP, buff=0.2)
        phase_label.next_to(circle, DOWN, buff=0.2)

        self.play(
            FadeOut(pulse1_d), FadeOut(pulse2_d), FadeOut(destructive_sum),
            Create(circle), Write(amp_label), Write(phase_label)
        )
        
        angle = ValueTracker(0)
        def update_phasor(m):
            start = self.grid["E3"]
            end = start + np.array([0.7 * np.cos(angle.get_value()), 0.7 * np.sin(angle.get_value()), 0])
            m.put_start_and_end_on(start, end)
            
        phasor.add_updater(update_phasor)
        self.add(phasor)
        
        self.play(angle.animate.set_value(PI/2), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(angle.animate.set_value(PI), run_time=1.5)
